game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor, a corridor of glyphs: the relic hunter must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of chalk marks while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor: a corridor of glyphs
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare double: declare resource as double, apply resource * 3.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 7 starts with [-3, 0, 17, 20]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Glyph Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
